listing.title: Submit Solana Project to Build for Breakpoint Track
listing.description:
About Superteam UK

Superteam UK is a community of founders, developers, and operators based in the UK, with a 24/7 startup hub at Somerset House.

We're running "Build for Breakpoint," which is a national push to get UK founders ready for accelerators before Solana Breakpoint 2026. Breakpoint is the solana ecosystem’s most important event of the year, and it will be November 15-17 at Olympia London.

One of these key accelerators we’re preparing founders for is Colosseum which requires a strong submission into World's Fair Hackathon for a chance to secure their $250k investment and 8-week accelerator in SF.

Mission

This track is for British founders who have secured their Build for Breakpoint Key. That means you've done the work on the Win Board to show PMF, and you're submitting to Crypto World's Fair. This is the chance to win more for funding and exposure.

$5,000 for the top 3, and a seat at the Demo Dinner with venture funds in London before Breakpoint for 1st place winner.

Submission Requirements

  • Your project must be submitted to the Colosseum portal by October 12th, as well as on Superteam Earn.

  • You must register on the Colosseum platform and select "United Kingdom" as your country.

  • You need to have earned your Key on the Build for Breakpoint Win Board at buildforbreakpoint.com before submissions close.

  • You must present your project at the Build for Breakpoint online Demo Day.

Judging Criteria

We judge the way the Win Board does: Have you found PMF and have recurring users:

  • Problem Validation: Have you talked to real users and proven they have the problem? Not a survey, not a hunch. Evidence that the pain exists and who feels it.

  • Users Finding Value: Is the product in front of people, and do users independently find value in it? Three real users who came back beats a hundred waitlist emails. Retention is the magic point.

  • Feasibility: Do you know how your users use it, what it costs you to serve them, and what your burn is? Founders who understand their numbers get funded. Founders who guess don't.

  • Growth Engine: Have you found your acquisition vehicle and the metric that proves it compounds? Acquire, retain, refer. Even an early loop counts if you can show it.

  • Demo Quality: Working product on Solana, not a roadmap. Could a fund back this after a five minute demo?

    Resources

  • Build for Breakpoint: buildforbreakpoint.com

  • Crypto World's Fair main hackathon page: colosseum.com/worldsfair

Reward Structure

  • 1st Place: 3000 USDG

  • 2nd Place: 1500 USDG

  • 3rd Place: 500 USDG

  • 1st place winner will also receive a seat at the Demo Dinner with venture funds in London.
